Method of Attack: Backdoor in firmware allowing attackers to compromise Over-the-Air (OTA) update operations and execute commands with root privileges
Man-in-the-Middle attack via unencrypted OTA update communications to send rogue commands
Impacted Systems: Multiple smartphone models from BLU Products
Smartphones from Infinix Mobility, DOOGEE, LEAGOO, IKU Mobile, Beeline, XOLO
Attack Vector: Insecure Over-the-Air (OTA) update system using unencrypted communications channel
Pre-installed firmware OTA system running as root with hidden processes
Indicators of Compromise: Three hard-coded OTA server domains (one tracked as CVE-2016-6564)
Unencrypted OTA update traffic vulnerable to Man-in-the-Middle attacks
